component.name: Memento
component.summary: Manage the games on a PS2 disk

description.p: Memento manages the games on a PlayStation 2 hard disk, SSD, SD card or USB drive from your computer, for the OPL and POPStarter way of playing. It contains no games and does not help find any: you need your own disc images.

ul.li: Install and remove PS2 games (ISO or ZSO) and PS1 games (BIN/CUE converted for POPStarter), one by one or in batches
Covers and other art, cheats, per-game settings and PS1 fixes
Virtual memory cards: list the saves, export and import them
Check a disc image against the Redump lists of good dumps
Also works on a mounted SD card or USB drive laid out like an OPL drive (for example in an MX4SIO adapter)

description.p: A PS2 hard disk or SSD is opened through the system's disk service: the system asks for your password once. SD cards and USB drives need no password.

screenshot.caption: The library: covers of the games on the disk and the details of the selected game

description.p: The application ID is now io.github.meramadness.Memento, for the Flatpak.
